usage.callShape: POST https://x402.auteng.ai/api/x402/compute with JSON body {code, stack?, size?, timeout_seconds?, files?}
usage.outputShape: body.stdout (program output), body.stderr, body.exit_code, body.execution_time_ms, body.files (filename→content map), body.sandbox_id, body.stack, body.size
usage.guide: POST a JSON body with a required `code` string to https://x402.auteng.ai/api/x402/compute, paying $0.002 USDC via x402 on Base. Set `stack` to "python" (default, Python 3.14) or "node" (Node.js 24 LTS); optional `size` (small/med/large), `timeout_seconds`, and `files` (filename→base64). The endpoint runs the code in an ephemeral sandbox and returns synchronously. Read program output from body.stdout, errors from body.stderr, and check body.exit_code (0 = success); any files produced appear in body.files.
